title: The capability doc gate rejects its own undocumented-reality placeholder

installed_sdk.rationale: No installed header, target, or exported symbol changes. The checker is a repository gate and ships in no SDK artifact.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, or handler is added or changed. The gate is invoked by the pre-push hook and CI, never as a shipped command.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler is added or changed. Nothing in tools/mcp reads the capability matrix.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, or profile policy changes. The gate constrains how a capability is documented, not what it can do.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged. Rejecting placeholder prose publishes no design-time capability.
